answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to capital locked. Like a pulse monitoring network health, this economic stake forces an attacker to accumulate vast assets, making the cost of creating fake identities exceed the potential gains. Much like a cooling ember, an attack vector loses its heat when identity costs become prohibitive. Even a walnut sized portion of the total supply carries sufficient weight to secure the protocol against unauthorized sybil proliferation.
